questions.question: What do the laws of this chapter mainly cover?
How were the Israelites told to treat foreigners (sojourners)?
options: To enslave them for hard labor
To drive them out of the land
To tax them more than the people
Not to wrong or oppress them
questions.answer: Not to wrong or oppress them

questions.question: They were commanded not to take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.
"You shall not allow a _____ to live," referring to those who practiced harmful magic.
They were not to oppress a _____ or a fatherless child.
